vanilla_structure_ring_search.conversion: cancellable @Inject at the HEAD of the static ChunkGenerator.getNearestGeneratedStructure for random-spread placements (selected by its full descriptor: in Mojang names the ConcentricRings overload has the same name): the same border cells in the same order, the same getPotentialStructureChunk and getStructureGeneratingAt (@Shadow) calls, the first hit returned; the interior cells are not walked. 1.21.1: the loop is unchanged; steps aside next to Structurify's wrapper of the getStructureGeneratingAt call (yield)
vanilla_structure_ring_search.license: Minecraft (Mojang): no-copy; the mixin carries only our own logic (helper bons.furious.patch.vanilla_structure_ring.StructureRing)

yields.name: Structurify
yields.why: Structurify (tested 1.21.1 2.0.42) @WrapOperation-wraps the getStructureGeneratingAt call inside ChunkGenerator.getNearestGeneratedStructure (random spread): with its placement-attempt option it re-resolves the candidate chunk before the check. This switch's HEAD replacement walks the same cells but calls getStructureGeneratingAt itself, which would bypass that wrapper and could locate a different structure, so it steps aside whenever that mixin is listed. Found by a scan of the other mods' mixins on the same classes for the 1.21.1 port (no crash class: HEAD injection).
